facts.value: Two colonies of bats have lived in the library for about two and a half centuries. They hunt the insects that feed on paper.
facts.quote: two colonies of bats have lived in the library to help with pest control
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://visit.uc.pt/en/space-list/joanina' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'two colonies of bats have lived in the library to help with pest control'

facts.value: At the end of each day the staff cover the tables with leather cloths, so the bats' droppings do not damage them overnight.
facts.quote: at the end of each day, the tables are covered with leather
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://visit.uc.pt/en/space-list/joanina' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'at the end of each day, the tables are covered with leather'

facts.value: The shelves are oak. The university says the wood's smell helps keep paper-eating insects away.
facts.quote: the shelves are made from oak, known for their density, durability, and odour that keeps insects away
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://visit.uc.pt/en/space-list/joanina' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'the shelves are made from oak, known for their density, durability, and odour that keeps insects away'

facts.value: Under the library is the university's academic prison. It is of medieval origin and is the oldest prison preserved in Portugal.
facts.quote: What we see is a prison of medieval origin, the oldest one that has been preserved in Portugal
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://visit.uc.pt/en/space-list/joanina' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'What we see is a prison of medieval origin, the oldest one that has been preserved in Portugal'

facts.value: Until 1834 the university had its own law and its own jail, so that professors, staff and students were not locked up with common criminals.
facts.quote: protected the academic community (professors, personnel and students) from living with common criminals
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://visit.uc.pt/en/space-list/joanina' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'protected the academic community (professors, personnel and students) from living with common criminals'
